verdict.rationale: Convex explicitly advertises itself as 'the open source, reactive database' and documents self-hosting where 'Self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend, and contains the same fully up-to-date code the cloud service uses,' backed by a public GitHub repo (get-convex/convex-backend) confirming the source is readable/available. Missing for 10: explicit license name/terms (e.g., Apache/MIT) and confirmation of independent third-party audit of license compliance.
